_comment: These use the game's OWN storm state, read straight from the engine:
field 'storm': 0 clear, 1 near a storm, 2 inside it (the ship is blown
along), 3 in the core (a ship of your fleet takes damage).
field 'wind':  the knots shown on the sailing HUD; it rises as a storm
nears. Ordinary sailing reads single figures.
Both read as calm unless the ship is under way.
Delete this file to turn these events off; the weather itself is unchanged.

events.body: The glass is falling, Captain. Weather to windward.
A green sea comes over the bow and sweeps the waist. When it clears there is a man in the water astern, and the ship is running before the gale.

options.text: Come about and search for him.
options.outcome: It costs you the best part of an hour fighting the sea, but they haul him over the rail half drowned. Your crew of {crew} will not forget that you went back.

options.text: Hold your course. You cannot stop in this.
options.outcome: You hold your course, and the man in the water falls astern and is gone. Nobody says anything. Nobody has to.

events.body: The storm passes astern. Shake out the reefs!
